summary: Frontend testing of P0 Cosmic Runner enhancements: obstacle spawning, obstacle speed, visual effects, skin store renders, and character animations. All features verified working correctly.
passed_tests: Obstacle spawning - isPositionClear() function prevents overlapping (verified via code review and gameplay screenshots showing obstacles in different lanes/depths)
Obstacle speed - all obstacles use same depthSpeed variable (g.speed * 0.008) confirming consistent speed across all lanes
Meteor obstacle visual - has fire aura, enhanced gradient core (white->yellow->orange->red), multiple fire trails, and ember particles (lines 590-639)
Debris obstacle visual - has fire edge glow and ember spots (lines 642-675)
Black hole visual - has outer danger glow and enhanced accretion disk with rings (lines 678-708)
Satellite visual - has danger glow and blinking warning light that toggles red (lines 711-751)
Alien ship visual - has UFO aura, enhanced body gradient, and animated lights (lines 754-800)
Mooncake visual - has sparkle glow, 4-pointed star rays, 8-pointed secondary rays, and orbiting sparkle particles (lines 805-900)
Character animation - running bob motion with bobAmplitude, lean forward when fast (leanAngle), jump squash/stretch (stretchY/squashY/stretchX) (lines 943-983)
Speed lines - motion blur effect when speed > 6 (lines 929-940)
Character afterimage trail - semi-transparent duplicates when speed > 8 (lines 974-981)
Skin Store - all 12 skins display with unified muscular bull renders (verified visually)
All 12 unified skin images exist: guardian, ethereal, diamond, gold, silver, heatmap, radioactive, zombie, water, fire, robot, skeletal
skins.js correctly references all _unified.png image paths
Game mechanics working: start, lane switching (A/D), jump (Space), collision detection, score tracking, mooncake collection
3D perspective rendering with converging lanes working correctly
Leaderboard integration working - 'Rank #3 this week!' notification displayed
seed_data_creation: Scores submitted to leaderboard during gameplay tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 enhancements verified: 1) isPositionClear() at lines 182-197 prevents obstacle/mooncake overlapping with 0.18 depth separation. 2) depthSpeed = g.speed * 0.008 used by ALL objects (obstacles at line 374, collectibles at line 382). 3) Enhanced obstacle visuals with fire effects (meteor: lines 590-639, debris: 642-675, blackhole: 678-708, satellite: 711-751, alienship: 754-800). 4) Mooncake sparkle with 8-pointed star at lines 826-861 + orbiting particles 887-900. 5) Character animation with bob/lean/squash-stretch at lines 943-983, speed lines 929-940, afterimage 974-981. 6) All 12 unified skins in /images/*_unified.png correctly referenced in skins.js.
